problem_summary: 11 citizen complaints about 'Fixing/Reparing Potholes' were recorded in Hongasandra between January 2019 and December 2020, spanning 2 calendar year(s). 36% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 19 pothole complaints.
9 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹3.8 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (exact_name join).
Ward recorded 178 road crashes in 2024, of which 42 were fatal.

agency_attribution_note: 11 of 11 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier MEDIUM (score=0.41). Top scoring factors: crash_risk=1.00, recurrence_years=0.67, complaint_volume=0.37.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Hongasandra' matched to datameet243=234 via exact_name (overlap_confidence=0.542).
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Hongasandra for the period 2019–2020.
Request inspection records for the 9 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
Cross-reference crash location data with cluster centroid to assess whether road condition may be a contributing factor to road accidents.
